packages_list.name: Kintamani - Ubud Tour
packages_list.description: Explore the best of Bali in one day, starting with a visit to the Silver & Gold Gallery and Batik Factory to witness traditional Balinese craftsmanship up close. Marvel at the stunning views of Kintamani Volcano, then experience a spiritual cleansing at the sacred Tirta Empul Holy Spring. Continue to the iconic Tegalalang Rice Terrace for breathtaking views and a thrilling swing experience, before wrapping up the day at the historic Ubud Palace.

terms_list.name: Standard tour terms apply.
Price updates may occur during peak seasons.

packages_list.name: Bedugul - Tanah Lot
packages_list.description: Discover the natural and spiritual beauty of Bali, starting with the enchanting Leke-Leke Waterfall hidden within a lush tropical forest. Continue to the serene Ulun Danu Floating Temple, majestically set on the shores of Lake Beratan, then end the day at the world-famous Tanah Lot Temple a breathtaking sea temple perched on a rocky cliff at sunset.

include_list.name: Parking fees and entrance fee based on above programs

terms_list.name: Minimum booking of 2 pax required.

packages_list.name: East Bali - Tour
packages_list.description: Uncover the mystical and natural wonders of East Bali, beginning with the iconic Lempuyang Temple famously known as the 'Gates of Heaven' with Mount Agung as its backdrop. Sweeten the journey with a stop at Layangan Sweetbefore marveling at the royal beauty of Tirta Gangga Water Palace, an elegant garden and water complex steeped in Balinese history. End the day at the magical Tukad Cepung Waterfall, a hidden gem tucked inside a dramatic cave canyon.

include_list.name: Parking fees and entrance fee based on above programs

terms_list.name: Bookings must be made in advance.

packages_list.name: Water Sport - Uluwatu Temple Tour
packages_list.description: Kick off the day with an exhilarating Banana Boat ride on the crystal-clear waters, then unwind on the stunning shores of Pandawa Beach and Padang-Padang Beach two of Bali's most breathtaking coastal gems. As the sun sets, head up to the clifftop Uluwatu Temple for a mesmerizing Kecak & Fire Dance Performance against a spectacular ocean backdrop.

destination_list.name: Uluwatu Temple with Kecak & Fire Dance Performance

include_list.name: Parking fees and entrance fee based on above programs

terms_list.name: Schedule subject to weather conditions for water sports.

packages_list.name: East - Tour
packages_list.description: Discover the stunning eastern side of Nusa Penida, starting with the breathtaking Atuh Beach — a secluded white sand beach framed by dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters. Continue to the equally spectacular Diamond Beach, where powdery white sand meets towering limestone cliffs for an unforgettable view. Cap off the adventure at the famous Tree House (Rumah Pohon Molenteng), a photogenic treetop hideaway offering panoramic views of the island's rugged coastline

terms_list.name: Safe footwear is recommended due to steep stairs at Diamond Beach.

packages_list.name: West - Tour
packages_list.description: Experience the raw beauty of Western Nusa Penida, starting with the iconic Kelingking Beach a dramatic T-Rex shaped cliff with stunning turquoise waters below. Continue to the natural wonder of Broken Beach, a breathtaking coastal arch carved by the ocean, then discover the mesmerizing natural infinity pool of Angel's Billabong right at the edge of the sea. End the day at the pristine and serene Crystal Bay, perfect for soaking in Bali's untouched island scenery.

terms_list.name: Please arrive at the harbor on time for the fast boat departure

packages_list.name: Swing - Activity
packages_list.description: Soar above Bali's lush tropical greenery at one of the island's most iconic photo spots. The package includes four types of swings  Single Swing, Extreme Swing, Couple Swing, and Bed Swing  plus a Bird Nest photo spot.
